'''Jaresh''' was a remote rainforest [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Jaresh system/Legends|Jaresh system]] in [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Its indigenous [[Tree/Legends|trees]] grew hundreds of [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in height. Its [[Local day/Legends|local day]] lasted 29 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]], and its [[local year]] lasted 98 local days. The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Ree Shala]] purchased Jaresh as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Ree Shala's Base|base]].
